settings.memoryMeasurement: Per-child wait4 peak resident set in bytes on Unix; null on platforms without wait4 or for aborted processes.

protocol.description: Four additional repositories and patch-derived task labels frozen before callback-test retrieval changes. Sparse agent-reviewed annotations; no independent reviewer was available. Corrective replays are regression data once scores have informed changes.

interpretation: Agent-reviewed patch-derived labels are sparse, not independently validated ground truth. Unclassified files are not noise. Failed cases contribute zero to recall and completeness. Supporting-range and judged-precision means show only available annotations; inspect annotation counts and errors. Public evaluation cases cease to be held out when used to tune ranking.
measurementNotes: Pinned archives and source labels are identical across paired methods/builds. Case batches overlap on a shared development host, so timings are diagnostic. Labels are sparse and agent-reviewed. Reserved-case results used for corrections are regression evidence.
